scope: Added-only model, provider mapping and coordination handoff; no timer/RTL implementation, live changes, simulator build, whole-provider or physical qualification.

WINDOW.limitation: FR_PIPE bookkeeping stops on fault although s_rdy remains high; pending zero alone is not a receipt.
WINDOW.required: WINDOW_OWNER_DRAIN_ACK(lease,revision): exact read retire/cancel ledger, frozen ingress, no latent write intent, publication invalidated.

MUX.limitation: Nested combinational mux has no lease ledger. w_wr_done is forwarded; CKV/RoPE writes are disabled in this source.
MUX.required: MUX_OWNER_DRAIN_ACK: withdraw WINDOW offer, include same-edge handshake, no retained WINDOW response/completion; other owners may continue.

KARB.limitation: kw_out covers K writes to issue ACK, not reads, WINDOW identity or physical visibility. Direct PIPE_OUT=0/PIPE_RSP=0 has no extra holding registers.
KARB.required: KARB_OWNER_DRAIN_ACK: owner accepted/retired ledger; no WINDOW offer or outstanding write-completion obligation. If pipeline parameters change include g_pipe.v_q and u_rsp holding state.

BACKEND.limitation: Filter ring live entries by TAG17 K=1, owner00; h_sched aliases Q head, rsp_v aliases R head. Whole q_n/r_n zero is stronger than WINDOW-owner zero. No exported owner-drain port or full generation identity.
BACKEND.required: BACKEND_OWNER_DRAIN_ACK: no owner Q/R/scheduled/registered offer or pending issue ACK, exact accepted identity ledger; sample after registered offer clears.

WRITE_INTENT.limitation: Producer EMPTY can precede source writes. Current WC_DONE creates WS after fault, and WS_DONE publishes without fault gate; current source has no cancel/intent-drain control.
WRITE_INTENT.required: WINDOW_WRITE_INTENT_DRAIN_ACK: cancel only withdrawn unaccepted sector with handshake exclusion; drain granted sector and accepted block follow-up unless separately cancelled; invalidate publication under fault.

WRITE_VISIBLE.limitation: wr_done is column-issue/mem[] commit; physical tail is not an exported completion. last_wr timing history is not per-owner completion identity.
WRITE_VISIBLE.required: BACKEND_WRITE_VISIBLE_DRAIN_ACK: all accepted owner writes acknowledged and physically visible, identity/order preserved; physical provider must specify tail/error completion. No timer implemented.

DELIVERY_FENCE.limitation: No FREEZE/FENCE lease request/ACK endpoint. Quiet cycles cannot exclude arbitrarily delayed duplicate/stale delivery or same-tag512 ghost.
DELIVERY_FENCE.required: DELIVERY_FENCE_ACK(lease,revision): closed exactly-once delivery through every boundary, no future old-lease return/completion; otherwise carry nonwrapping identity end-to-end.

fence_protocol: Freeze WINDOW admission and publication; latch lease/revision and capture concurrent handshakes before deciding cancellation.
Withdraw unaccepted offers with explicit exclusion receipt, or drain only the pre-fault accepted block obligations. Invalidate affected row/stage.
Retire/cancel exact identities at all hops; keep accepting owned responses despite fault; wait for all accepted write visible receipts.
Wait for final registered offer/ACK to clear; collect fresh owner-empty receipts at same lease/revision. Other-owner work may remain.
Close transport exactly-once fence and collect no-future-delivery ACK. Any late arrival invalidates receipts and preserves fault.
Commit owner-local restart only after every receipt; advance lease/epoch, rebuild invalid publication. Shared rn reset instead needs every client/stack in its reset domain drained.

owner_vs_global.owner_restart: Owner-local epoch/lease restart can coexist with other clients only with exact owner ledger, no latent intent, physical write visibility and closed transport fence. This predicate is prospective; no actual provider is implemented.
owner_vs_global.global_reset: Shared rn covers all reset-domain clients/stacks; requires freeze and drain for every owner including physical write tails, not only WINDOW on WIN_STACK. All q/r zero is still insufficient if a write tail/registered ACK remains. A distinct reset-domain fence covering every client is mandatory even when aggregate queues are zero; owner receipts cannot stand in for it.
owner_vs_global.tag17: bit16=1 K vs bit16=0 B/weight; bits15:14=00 WINDOW,01 CKV,10 RoPE; lower14 epoch9+sector5 for qualified candidate; wire tag is not full lease identity.
owner_vs_global.queue_counts: Filter occupied ring slots with owner tag, not unused storage; h_sched aliases Q head, rsp_v aliases R head. Check offers separately as emptiness predicates without double-counting credits.

fault_write_policy.producer_unaccepted: Withdraw before any blk handshake and receipt exclusion; producer EMPTY is not downstream completion.
fault_write_policy.block_accepted: Pre-fault accepted block owns WC and WS intent. Cancel ungranted sector only with explicit withdrawal/grant exclusion and invalidate row/stage; otherwise drain its write obligations. Fault is never permission to cancel accepted WR.
fault_write_policy.wc_done: Wait for issued WC completion/physical visibility. WS follow-up either explicitly cancelled before grant or drained as the existing accepted-block obligation, not new producer admission.
fault_write_policy.ws_done: Drain accepted WS through ACK and physical visibility; prevent faulted publication before restart.
fault_write_policy.same_edge: Capture handshakes before applying fault/cancellation. Concurrent grant forces drain.
fault_write_policy.current_implementation: No intent cancellation/withdraw ACK exists; WC_DONE->WS and WS_DONE publication are not fault-gated. Required future control is explicitly missing, not silently assumed.

bounded_liveness.assumptions: Positive externally supplied upper bounds A on request acceptance, S on accepted service including all refresh/competitor interference, R on return-ready/handshake, V on issue-to-visible receipt, F on closed fence/receipt propagation. Freeze WINDOW new admission; drain pre-fault intent only; competitors must meet service bound, not merely average fairness.
bounded_liveness.conservative_formula_cycles: Nread*(A+S+R) + Nwrite_intent*(A+S+V) + 1 registered-clear edge + F; Nread<=8, Nwrite_intent<=32 (row-envelope conservative). No numeric RTL bound asserted.
bounded_liveness.absence_of_bounds: No finite liveness guarantee under indefinitely held returns, stalled ACKs or competitor starvation. MAXSKIP16/lowest-PC priority alone does not establish these bounds.

interface_and_cost.receipt_identity: actor3 + lease64 + revision64 + empty1 =132 logical bits per serialized model receipt, same transaction identity across all actors; physical representation unselected.
interface_and_cost.aggregate_control: At least seven fresh-ACK bits attached to existing lease/revision; two more actor ACKs than original five-actor read-only model. Write visibility/latent intent ledger remains separately priced in prior record.
interface_and_cost.routes: Prospective freeze/withdraw and receipt aggregation across producer/WINDOW, mux, KARB, backend, visible-completion and transport-fence boundaries. No route-track/area/SSFF or token-latency qualification; integration must price selected encoding in unified model before RTL.
interface_and_cost.latency: Conditional formula above only; healthy publication timer cost not selected. No cold-refill timing delta reused as recovery cost.

clock_reset.source: rtl/w17_runtime/chip/ot_chip_v41x_die.sv:375-378; one clk, async rst_s assertion, rn release after two clk edges.
clock_reset.consumers: WINDOW/mux/KARB state uses async negedge rn; idx backend tests !rst_n synchronously at posedge. This is one modeled source clock/reset path, not physical CDC/clock closure evidence.
clock_reset.timing: idx CLK_PS1000, CWL6250 and BURST1024 source defaults in this path. Planned streaming1.2GHz/serial0.9GHz domains do not change these source-bound provider obligations without qualification.

nash_handoff.timer_decision: DEFER: no timer implementation authorized before healthy causal read-safety composition.
nash_handoff.healthy_dependency: Nash must bind final WC/WS issue/ACK order to each actual subsequent same-PC read schedule and its WR-to-RD constraint, including sector PC mapping, scale-last ordering, injection allocation and interference. Logical row publication need not itself mean physical drain if every consuming read is safely delayed.
nash_handoff.recovery_dependency: Even if healthy read safety passes, recovery must obtain WRITE_VISIBLE plus delivery fence; restart/reset cannot rely on a subsequent RD enforcing turnaround.
nash_handoff.requested_owner_response: Return source-pinned causal ordering proof or counterexample and exact required publication condition before selecting any healthy timer.
nash_handoff.coordination_status: Durable handoff only; no direct agent-message capability and no Nash acknowledgement asserted.
nash_handoff.healthy_timer_cost_if_needed: Prior 7-cycle/4-bit proposal remains conditional at CLK_PS1000, not implemented or selected.
nash_handoff.liveness: Finite bounds must cover accept fairness, backend service incl refresh/other clients, downstream ready, physical completion and fence. MAXSKIP16 and lowest-PC selection alone do not supply this contract. Unbounded holding/starvation implies no finite completion bound; timeout preserves ownership.

test_evidence.runtime: pytest-only bounded local run; no build
coverage: conditional bounds and timeout ownership preservation
